title: Patient Accounting Standard: Enrolled Amount of an Encounter Charge on a Proposed Patient Payment Plans Plan
content:
This standard fixes the amount at which a charge posted for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed Patient Payment Plans plan is enrolled on that plan, and which such charge is enrolled first.

**1. Order of enrollment.** Where several such charges stand unenrolled, the most recently posted one is enrolled first.

**2. Enrolled amount.** The enrolled amount of such a charge is its remaining balance on the enrollment date:

- the *counted amount* is the charge amount as posted on the Patient Financial Account;
- the *credited payments* are every payment the financial account shows applied to the charge;
- the *remaining balance* is the counted amount less every time-of-service collection, the credited payments and every adjustment the financial account shows applied to the charge, never below 0.00;
- the enrolled amount is the remaining balance, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end (an amount exactly halfway between two cents goes to the higher cent).

**3. Records read.** The charge's amount, and the time-of-service collections, payments and adjustments on the financial account that apply to that charge.

### Worked figures (hypothetical charges)

| Item | Charge A | Charge B |
|---|---|---|
| Charge amount (counted amount) | 480.00 | 100.00 |
| Time-of-service collection applied | 40.00 | 0.00 |
| Payments applied (credited) | 100.00 | 120.00 |
| Adjustments applied | 25.50 | 0.00 |
| Remaining balance | 314.50 | 0.00 (never below 0.00) |
| Enrolled amount | 314.50 | 0.00 |

**Order (hypothetical).** Two unenrolled charges of an enrolled encounter, one posted on 3 May and one posted on 17 May: the charge posted on 17 May is enrolled first.
